resources.string: Ctrl+Shift+D saves clipboard images as PNG; Ctrl+Shift+C picks screen color HEX

Provides two global keyboard shortcuts:

• Ctrl + Shift + D: Converts any image on the clipboard (WebP, JPEG, PNG, etc.) into a lossless PNG in Downloads and opens an animated drag-and-drop popup.
• Ctrl + Shift + C: Opens a precision crosshair and zoom magnifier to click any pixel on screen and copy its #RRGGBB HEX color code to the clipboard.

Runs 100% offline with zero network permissions.
